title: Firstfruits and the Tithe Confession
description: Moses gives instructions on how the Israelites are to bring the first fruits of the land's produce to the place the Lord chooses, place it in a basket, and hand it over to the priest with a declaration that they have come to the land the Lord swore to give their fathers. The confession tells of the homeless Aramean who went down to Egypt, about the oppression there, the cry to the Lord, and deliverance with a strong hand and an outstretched arm to a land flowing with milk and honey. In the third year, the tenth year, the tithe is to be given to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and the giver shall before the face of the Lord confirm that the command has been fulfilled and ask the Lord to look down from his holy dwelling and bless the people and the land.
